description:
Activate Relic of Sauron by tapping it, adding {1}{U}
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Relic of Sauron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Relic of Sauron onto the battlefield.
When Relic of Sauron enters, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, as Relic of Sauron is a land due to Toph, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
